# CSN fixtures (round CDS2)

Test input for `fabric_backend/csn.py`. Nothing here was exported from an SAP system, and nothing here is customer
metadata. A CSN file a customer exports from their own tenant stays with them and never goes into this repository.

| File | What it is | Source and licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `datasphere_bike_sales_model.json` | The CSN of the ER model of SAP's public "Bike Sales" sample for SAP Datasphere: 9 entities, keys, `@Common.Label`, 10 unmanaged associations without cardinality. CSN 0.2, `meta.kind` `sap.dwc.ermodel`. | The file `Sample_Bikes_Sales_content/Bike Sales Model.json` of github.com/SAP-samples/datasphere-content at commit `695af09278d8a57d0fb0a441f247060eaea5daf5` (28 May 2026), unmodified, SHA-256 `9b1f92461ed63b56aeb146994fe6086fe33d128ae144f243d4b328bbc61196de`. Licence: Apache License 2.0, read in the repository's `LICENSE` file at that commit; its `.reuse/dep5` says `Files: *`, `License: Apache-2.0`, Copyright 2019-2023 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company and data-warehouse-cloud-content. The repository has no `NOTICE` file. The licence text is kept here as `LICENSE-datasphere-content.txt`. Fetched with `git clone` from GitHub on 16 November 2026. |
| `interop_airline.json`, `interop_cap_ariba_supplier_service.json` | SAP's public examples of CSN Interop Effective 1.2 (the CSN profile SAP specifies for exchanging metadata between applications): an airline model with `@ObjectModel.modelingPattern`, `@Semantics.amount.currencyCode`, `@Semantics.quantity.unitOfMeasure`, `@ObjectModel.foreignKey.association`, text associations, and a model compiled by the CDS compiler 5.4.2. | The files `spec/v1/examples/airline.json` (SHA-256 `6e9a2a1b90b88ef47e316c5d72aab715ffbced57db519864acdadc34f68328ce`) and `spec/v1/examples/cap/ariba-supplier-service.json` (SHA-256 `a14d791fe2b379b41b60ed04e5d772429468f2ba9526b6c416240fdac1d5d92b`) of github.com/SAP/csn-interop-specification at commit `ccf90cbba0be6eae411be4cf8356c2989c40bd30` (9 November 2026), unmodified. Licence: Apache License 2.0, read in the repository's `LICENSE` file at that commit; its `REUSE.toml` gives `path = "**"`, `Apache-2.0`, Copyright 2024 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company and csn-interop-specification contributors. No `NOTICE` file. The licence text is kept here as `LICENSE-csn-interop-specification.txt`. Fetched with `git clone` from GitHub on 16 November 2026. |
| `synthetic_service_orders.json` | **Synthetic**, hand-written for the tests: custom views named `ZI_*` (service orders, items, customers, products, product texts) in CSN `$version` 2.0, with key elements, associations with cardinality, `@Semantics.amount.currencyCode`, `@Semantics.quantity.unitOfMeasure`, `@Semantics.currencyCode`, `@Semantics.text`, `@ObjectModel.text.element`/`.association`, `@ObjectModel.foreignKey.association`, `@Analytics.dataCategory`, a filtered association with a literal, a `type` and a `service` definition. Its `meta.creator` says it is synthetic. | Written in this repository (MIT). The annotation names and value forms follow SAP's public CSN and ABAP CDS vocabulary as described in CAP's documentation (github.com/cap-js/docs, `cds/csn.md`, `cds/annotations.md`, commit `891141c0a91817f575192e6cfac3f6d56b9eed82`, Apache-2.0, read, not copied). |
| `synthetic_cap_bookshop.json` | **Synthetic**, hand-written in the shape `cds compile --to csn` gives a small CAP model: namespaced entities (`my.bookshop.Books`), managed associations with `keys`, one without (`genre`: the target's key), a structured element, a `$self` backlink, `@Measures.ISOCurrency`, a `context` definition. Not compiled by CAP. | Written in this repository (MIT), after the same documentation. |

The rows the engine is run on (`fabric_backend/csn_demo.py`) are synthetic too.
